definitions.explanation: The examination of a dead body to determine the cause and manner of death. Includes both external examination by police/prosecutors and internal examination (autopsy) by a medical examiner.

examples.japanese: {検死|けんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心不全|しんふぜん}→心不全：28546_shinfuzen⟧だった。
examples.english: The postmortem examination determined the cause of death was heart failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{検死|けんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The police are conducting a postmortem examination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{検死|けんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A postmortem examination is always conducted in cases of suspicious death.

notes: Composed of {検|けん} (examine, inspect) + ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death). Strictly speaking, {検死|けんし} refers to the external examination of a body (also written ⟦{検視|けんし}→検視：21854_kenshi⟧), while ⟦{解剖|かいぼう}→解剖：14191_kaibou⟧ or ⟦{司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}→司法解剖：25185_shihoukaibou⟧ refers to the internal autopsy. However, in common usage {検死|けんし} often covers both. Common collocations: {検死|けんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to conduct a postmortem), {検死|けんし}⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧ (autopsy report), {検死|けんし}{官|かん} (coroner/medical examiner). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{剣士|けんし}→剣士：11912_kenshi⟧ (swordsman). Frequently appears in mystery novels and crime dramas.
